critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/holerite.py is ~1170 lines — consider splitting into holerite_admin.py / holerite_ai.py / holerite_public.py for maintainability.

Public endpoints /public/by-collaborator/{cid} and /public/{cid}/{doc_id}/sign-upload rely only on knowing cid for authentication — currently acceptable per design, but consider rate-limiting + audit log already in place (good).

_has_pdf_signature uses substring scan (/ByteRange, /Sig) on first+last 50KB — a malicious actor could append fake markers to bypass (as my test PDF demonstrates: signature_valid=true even though it is not a real PKCS#7 signed PDF). The endpoint correctly tags this as a hint, not a cryptographic verification. Consider documenting this limitation in the response payload (warning text) or integrate with pyHanko / endesive for real PKCS#7 validation.
Frontend MyHoleritesModal.js uses inline styles heavily; consider extracting to CSS module / Tailwind classes for consistency with the rest of the app.
